cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?

mechanism: A licenses the wording of an account while extracting what witnesses actually saw, minimizing personal disclosure.
confusable: Being defensive is insufficient: A must assume the right to approve what B may report.
comparison: Unlike the party witness inquiry, this is a workplace report where B asks to pass information to a manager.
seedUse: Retain D06-b missing-key witness progression; transform S01 supervision into control of B report wording.
